newsitem.title: USA: Buckhead earned $0.28 a share in yr-ago Q1.
newsitem.headline: Buckhead earned $0.28 a share in yr-ago Q1.

text.p: Buckhead America Corp said on Tuesday that in the first quarter of 1996 it earned $503,105, or $0.28 a share.
The company said that it would report investment gains of $1.25 million or $0.68 a share for the first quarter of 1997.

The company's investment gains result from the second $800,000 installment in the previously disclosed sale of a second mortgage on a Days Inns hotel in Chicago, Illinois, and a $450,000 gain from the recall of a Birmingham, Alabama, industrial revenue bond held by the company.
Buckhead has completed the joint venture purchase of a 49-room hotel in San Antonio, Texas, for conversion into a Country Hearth Inn & Suites hotel.
Both investments were inherited by Buckhead America from the Days Inns of America Inc bankruptcy, it said.
